description: MUTATES Accelo data: logs an activity (a note, email, call, or meeting) against an object. This is the highest-value safe write — e.g. add a note/comment to a job or company. against_type + against_id say what it is logged against (required). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/activities (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

against_id.description: The id of the object this activity is logged against (required).

against_type.description: The object type this activity is logged against, e.g. "company", "job", "issue", "prospect", "contact" (required).

body.description: The activity body/message text (the note content).

fields.description: Additional documented Accelo fields to send in the write body (merged with the typed fields above).

medium.description: Communication medium, e.g. "note", "email", "call", "meeting". Defaults to a note on the Accelo side.

owner_id.description: The owner id (e.g. the staff id).

owner_type.description: The owner object type, e.g. "staff" (who logged/owns the activity).

name: create_activity
title: Create an activity (log a note/email/call)
